reviews.text: I see there's already a similar comment to the one I'm about to post. My father had a serious accident and is fighting for his life. He refused to help us find a solution to prevent my dog ​​from being admitted because of this situation. I can only say that he shows zero empathy for personal situations and is completely inflexible.
Excellent daycare! My dog ​​had a great time. Adriana sent me photos whenever I asked and was always very kind. We'll definitely be back! Ponchito stayed with her for a month and came back happy.
Adri was very kind and has extensive experience caring for furry friends. My Camila was very calm.
My pets appreciate the hospitality and good treatment
Thank you !

Excellent service. Adriana was very attentive from the first contact, providing me with all the information clearly and answering all my questions. During his stay, she kept me updated on my dog's condition. Without a doubt, they will be my first choice for his care in the future.

Thank you so much. They took such good care of my baby. I can share it with other dogs. They always kept me informed and sent me photos of how he was doing. I would definitely leave my baby with them again. Thank you so much.

Adri provided excellent service from the moment I contacted her. I left my two dogs, first at a kennel and then at a hotel, and I was very relaxed during my trip. I was a little worried because one of them is very anxious, but she ate everything! And Adri sent me photos whenever I asked :).
I will definitely continue to take them there! And I highly recommend her!
I'm so happy! Dalí came back happy, ate all his food, and Adi is such a wonderful person. She sent pictures, and my little one looked so grateful and calm. Thank you, Adi!! Big hug 😘 …

My Molly was very happy and calm with Adi for a whole week at the hotel. It was the second time I'd left her at a kennel, and I felt so sad leaving her alone. Adi was amazing, and it gave me so much peace of mind knowing Molly was safe.
A great place to leave Copito; we were very satisfied with their care, and we already know where to leave him again in the future. Thank you so much, Adi.
Excuse me, I don't know you, how can you rate a service you haven't used?

From the moment you contact them, the information is very clear and precise. They take care to thoroughly check my dog's vaccination record and answer any questions you may have. My dog ​​feels calm and relaxed, and when I pick her up, she's very calm, clean, and happy. The price is reasonable.
Excellent service and communication

Excellent dog hotel option. My dogs came back happy. I liked that they only accept small breeds and they aren't kept in cages.
Adi explains everything very clearly from the beginning, which gave me confidence. We will definitely be back!
Excellent
How can someone give an opinion when they haven't used my service?

The best place for your pet. Adri was very clear from the beginning about everything, including care, requirements, costs, hours, and especially emphasizing that it was a cage-free boarding facility, which I think is a huge help for our dogs and cats when we're away. Without a doubt, the best option, 100% recommended.

Adriana provided excellent service for our dog. I loved that they didn't keep him in a cage, which gave him a home-like experience. The prices are very reasonable, and the service was truly personalized. We will definitely return in the future.

Leaving my dog ​​with Adri was the best decision. I left him for seven days and was worried because he's very attached to me, but he adjusted at all. Adri makes them feel right at home. Every time I asked about my dog, Ares, she answered and sent me photos and videos. She treats them very well and is wonderful with dogs! This will definitely be the hotel I always use!
Very friendly, excellent service
Excellent service. They are very kind and respectful. Whenever we asked about our dog, they gave us information.

I was staying in Narvarte for the summer with my dog and came across Adi’s services. She is amazing. She has opened up her home to dogs in her care. No crates or cages! (My girl loves a couch). Adi is very professional when it comes to learning everything about you and your pup. She documents everything! She will also send pics and videos ensuring everything is going well. You never have to worry. It’s clear she loves animals very much. Don’t speak Spanish? No worries. Communication via Google translate was very easy and efficient with Adi. I’m so happy I found her and will continue to use her services every time I travel! Thank you Adi and team for all that you do.

My dog ​​stayed with Adri for 11 days and it was clear she was well cared for. She would send me photos whenever I asked about her. Adri's attention and explanation of the boarding process were excellent. I highly recommend Adi Pata de Perro; I will definitely take my dog ​​there again.

Leaving our Cobi in Adri's care was a great decision. We were very satisfied with the service. During his stay, he took the time to share a video with us and describe how our dog was doing, which put our minds at ease. From our very first interaction, Adri demonstrated knowledge and a passion for dog care. My Cobi was very happy when we returned. We will definitely choose Adri for our next vacation. Thank you so much.
Excellent place to leave the dogs. Adi was always attentive, and my dogs returned home with no changes in their behavior.

We were extremely satisfied with Adri's service and attention. Every day she sent us photos and kept us updated on how everything was going. I highly recommend her dog hotel; you won't regret it. These days it's hard to find a place so …

I highly recommend leaving your pet with Adi 🥰 She's super dedicated, careful, and truly passionate and committed to her work. My dog ​​is so happy when he's with her, and I have peace of mind knowing he's in the best hands. …
Excellent pet care, very happy with the hotel service they provided for my pet, highly recommended 😊🤗 …

Adi took excellent care of Tango! She inspired confidence and clearly looked after my dog ​​well. She informed us about Tango's behavior at the end of his stay and offered ways to help him with his clingy and possessive personality. …
